profile.headline: Graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a Bachelors degree in Computer Science
profile.summary: Skilled in Computer Science, Databases, and ML. Interested in gaining experience and seeing the future of big data and AI in the future. Currently working on Java-based solutions as an Associate Software Engineer for Northwestern Mutual primarily in backend implementations.

positions.title: Student Staff
positions.description: Manage and proctor exams for students with disabilities and maintain office procedures that involve scheduling and maintaining the privacy of the students which use our services. Also wrote a text parser to help edit some documents we format for students with visual impairment.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: As a Resident Assistant, I planned and executed major dorm events, connected a diverse group of residents with on-campus resources, advised first year students on college life, made the dorm a safe and comfortable home, and acted as a custodian to the hall.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Worked to import a project which utilized Microsoft SQL Server to a Web-based solution through AWS. I also implemented a listener to pull from AWS SQS and improve the project by increasing the turnaround time through threading.

volunteerExperiences.description: Learned and would meet weekly to discuss teaching techniques of Take Ten followed by teaching kids at the Robinson Community Learning center peaceful resolution to conflicts.

Took a course where I learned teaching techniques as well as those to teach students with visual disabilities.  Took two trips to travel to the Illinois School for the Visually Impaired to aid in their Computer course where we helped the students program their own games in the Quantum programming language.
